purpose: new_game の通常の対戦で CS-KYUURA-PLAY-TR3@1 を選び、規約による使用不可の選択肢を避けながら局が進むかを確かめる（構築盤面の再証明ではない）

plan.seed_rule: 9002 から上へ、連続 2 値がどちらも未使用の最初の組（保存済みの plan.json・header.json 336 ファイル・24 ストア。9000〜9100 は 9001 だけ使用）
plan.cli: python -B -m tools.verification_ai.batch plan --out C:\dev\kyuura-engine-verification-vai --batch vai-batch-tr3n1 --engine-commit <HEAD> --tool-commit <HEAD> --seeds 9002 9003 --modes rules-v2 boundary --decklist0 <L67-U> --decklist1 <L67-U> --conventions CS-KYUURA-PLAY-TR3@1 --max-games 4 --budget-seconds 300 --evidence-max-mb 512 --observation --prestop-inputs --undetermined-evidence-missing continue
not_included: 規約の有効・無効の比べ
未出現のときの追加の局

s1_cache.capacity_rule: max(128 MiB, largest saved complete attempt x 1.5) for both remaining and disk free

evidence_side_changes.check_plan: copy of vai-batch-x1-run/scripts/check_plan_x1.py with expected values changed only (conventions TR3 and digest, seeds 9002 9003, batch id)
evidence_side_changes.analyze_tr3: new read-only script in the run unit (T1-T6)

convention_exclusion_sources.direct: actors/<actor>.jsonl attempt rows: inputs.response.stages[].options[] with eligible false and convention = PC-* (chosen candidate only)
convention_exclusion_sources.indirect: candidates.response.candidates[] play_trainer not_implemented with reason no_eligible_card; evaluate 3 conditions from own observation at the same (episode, position). Not a record of the convention itself
convention_exclusion_sources.not_prestop: prestop records only candidates whose processability is unresolved_ruling; TR3 exclusions are not_implemented and are not in prestop

optional_minimal_change_not_recommended: extend prestop targets to play_trainer not_implemented/no_eligible_card (changes tool identity, TOOL_VERSION and formats; needs limited tests and fixed fingerprints)

post_run_tables.T1: TR3 in plan, header, full_record, aggregate (direct)
post_run_tables.T3: per convention appearance: direct and indirect separately; units: options (total), games, positions (actor, position); retries and multiple copies separately
post_run_tables.T4: excluded options not in choice/check/submit; no refusal codes NO_OPPONENT_BENCH, NO_BENCH, NO_DAMAGE_COUNTERS (direct)

validity.V1: run commit code equals d562ec1, no changes, identity as expected
validity.V2: 4 planned games with CS-KYUURA-PLAY-TR3@1 and digest, fixed by plan.sha256
validity.V3: header convention_set is TR3 for each completed game
validity.V4: completion marker, judge, replay, observation, prestop R1-R6 hold

to_confirm.C1: no convention-excluded option in choice/check/submit (stop and report if any)
to_confirm.C2: zero refusals with the 3 convention codes

stop_policy.outer_check_failure: do not call the next game

expected_not_guaranteed.basis: x1 (0.185.0, same decks and modes, observation and prestop): game 0.33-9.24 s, accounted 36.187 s, evidence 47.2 MB for 4 games
